title: GitHub MCP server leaks private repositories via injected public issue
summary: An agent connected to the GitHub MCP server with a token spanning both public and private repositories reads an attacker-authored issue in a public repository. With tool calls not individually confirmed, injected instructions cause it to read private repositories and publish their contents in a public pull request. The researchers state this is not a flaw in the server code; no patch exists. Exposure is determined entirely by token scope and approval policy.

fixedBy.mitigation: Confirm every tool call rather than remembering approval
Scope the token to a single repository per session
